diagnostics.message: aws_cloudtrail.main only references aws_s3_bucket.cloudtrail.id, so nothing forces aws_s3_bucket_policy.cloudtrail to exist before the trail is created. CloudTrail validates the bucket policy (s3:GetBucketAcl / s3:PutObject for cloudtrail.amazonaws.com) during CreateTrail and fails with InsufficientS3BucketPolicyException if the policy isn't attached yet. The AWS provider docs for aws_cloudtrail explicitly show `depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket_policy.example]` on the trail; add `depends_on = [aws_s3_bucket_policy.cloudtrail]` to aws_cloudtrail.main (no attribute-level fix exists, since aws_s3_bucket_policy exports no attributes).
